meaning:
Ain = "spring"
one of the landmarks on the eastern boundary of Palestine
Also named: rim.mon (רִמּוֹן, רִמּוֹנוֹ "Rimmon" H7417)

elsewhere.note: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth…
Lebaoth, Shilhim, Ain, and Rimmon. All the cities are twenty-nine, with their villages.
Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;
